proposal.title: Wheatfield Resonance
proposal.idea: A multi-plane wheat field swaying beneath a warm sunset, with the golden wheat stalks responding to the acoustic guitars and vocals.
proposal.geometry: A 16:9 aspect ratio with two depth planes, one for the backlit wheat stalks and another for the foreground wheat stalks.
proposal.typography: The worship lyric band will be displayed in the Noto Serif typeface, with each line taking up to five seconds to ensure legibility.
proposal.imageLogic: The wheat fields will be procedurally generated, with the wheat stalks swaying in response to the audio cues.
proposal.texture: The wheat stalks will have a subtle grain texture to give them a tactile feel.
proposal.motion: The wheat stalks will sway in response to the acoustic guitars and vocals, with smooth motion to match the slow pace of the scene.
proposal.productionMethod: This direction will be made using a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer.
proposal.humanTrace: The wheat stalks will be simulated using paper tooth and ink bleed, giving them a physical appearance.
proposal.risk: The risk is the potential for the wheat stalks to become too distracting or overwhelming.

arguesWith.why: The Classical Mind may argue that a quieter reveal is preferred, but this direction aims to create a spectacle of motion and contrast.
